rows.grounds: numeral member of compound with patra
second member of compound with aṣṭa
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, possessing a pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is described as royal in nature.
It possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled center distinguished by the presence of a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific name or location of this sixth cakra is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
